result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on prior findings SV-00F-001 and SV-00F-002, the implementor's directly touched chunk/fixture/accounting/placeholder surfaces, and gate evidence after cleanup. Canonical chunk state is now separated from explicit legacy placeholder state, semantic lower-band accounting now takes precedence over placeholder text, and the configured story and epic gates passed.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved. `ChunkState` is now a union of `CanonicalChunkState` and `LegacyPlaceholderChunkState`; canonical chunks declare `placeholders?: never`, while legacy chunks declare `schemaVersion?: never`, `conversationTranscript?: never`, and `lowerBand?: never` in `src/thread/async-thread/domain/chunk-state.ts`. `makeChunkState()` now accepts `Partial<CanonicalChunkState>` and emits canonical records without a `placeholders` field, while `makeLegacyPlaceholderChunkState()` is the explicit placeholder-era builder in `src/thread/async-thread/test/fixtures.ts`. Thread-view fixture setup now uses `makeLegacyPlaceholderChunkState()` for placeholder-backed closed chunks, and `tests/thread/foundation.test.ts` asserts canonical builders cannot create placeholder hybrids.

Resolved. Both detailed/brief counting implementations now resolve `chunk.lowerBand` before legacy `chunk.placeholders` in `src/token-accounting/materialized-representation-counter.ts` and `src/token-accounting/openai-input-token-counter.ts`. `tests/thread/foundation.test.ts` adds a hybrid-shaped regression fixture and asserts detailed/brief representation hashes come from semantic lower-band artifact text.

additionalObservations: `npm run verify` passed with 442 service tests, including the new canonical-vs-legacy chunk fixture tests and semantic accounting precedence test.
`npm run verify-all` passed, including the embedded service suite, 14 standard E2E tests, and the three long-thread PI execution E2E cases.
The focused long-thread prep service test remains expensive at roughly 71 seconds, consistent with the implementor's note, but it is not blocking Story 0 readiness.
